**`grep '^  FAIL' "$TMP/out" | grep -qF "$want"` (`scripts/negative-test-accept.sh:101`) is the SIGPIPE trap this repo already documented and worked around.** `accept-release.sh:23-26`: “Captured rather than piped into `grep -q`: under `set -o pipefail`, grep -q exits on the first match, [the producer] dies of SIGPIPE, and the pipeline reports failure.” `negative-test-accept.sh:44` sets `-o pipefail`. Latent today because FAIL output is far under the 64KB pipe buffer, so the producer always finishes writing first — but if it ever fires it reports a *detected* mutation as `WRONG`. Capture to a variable, as the sibling script does.
